user.title: Floorplan card companion
user.description: Serves the floor plan card to every dashboard and runs what must work without a tablet: the front door warning, walk reminders and check-offs for all devices, and the live position of the robot vacuum. Everything is set up from the card.

frontend_missing.title: Floor plan card: card file missing
frontend_missing.description:
The companion integration is set up, but the card's file (`frontend/floorplan-card.js`) is missing from its folder. Dashboards therefore cannot show the floor plan card.

Reinstall the floor plan card through HACS (HACS → Floor plan card → Redownload) and restart Home Assistant afterwards.
